name: Ledger fixed functional gold · SOL vs ASTRA IQ3_S
description: Second task family: fixed ledger/API edge-case checks plus compilation. Identical contract and grader for both profiles; agent/infrastructure errors are separately labeled.

prompts.prompt:
Return the complete contents of `solution_ledger_fixed.py` as your entire response. The benchmark saves the final response as that file. Output only valid Python source: no thoughts, `<think>` tags, Markdown, explanations, or tool calls. Keep it concise.

Implement a standard-library-only personal ledger. API: `Entry` dataclass with id, date, payee, amount, category, note; `Ledger` with `add(date,payee,amount,category,note="")`, `entries()`, `balance()`, `undo()`, `filter_entries(category=None,start=None,end=None,query=None)`, `summary()`, `to_csv()`, `from_csv(text)`; module function `parse_amount(value)`.

Rules: parse Decimal amounts including `$` and thousands commas, round half-up to cents, reject malformed amounts. Validate real ISO dates, nonblank payee and category; trim payee and lowercase trimmed category. Preserve signed values (income positive, expense negative). IDs start at 1 and increase; CSV round-trip preserves entries and IDs so new entries continue above prior max. `entries()` and filters preserve insertion order. Balance is signed total. Summary has Decimal keys `income` (sum positive), `expenses` (absolute sum negative), `balance`, integer `count`, and Decimal `by_category` signed sums. Filters combine category (case-insensitive), inclusive ISO date bounds, and case-insensitive substring over payee/note. Undo reverses the latest add exactly and returns false when empty. CSV correctly quotes commas and quotes.

The harness runs 8 fixed external checks plus py_compile, the same for each profile. Do not author or inspect tests. Output one complete module only.
